---
title: "Research"
---


My research focuses on heterogeneity within group politics, with broader interests in
race and ethnicity, migration, and discrimination. Primarily, my research focuses on the United States
and Africa. My dissertation explores both of these interests by conducting an in-depth case study
of Eritrean immigrants to uncover how home country socialization towards politics and
identity matter for incorporation in the United States. Other work of mine explores how identity (race, religion, nativity)
matter for political attitude formation, candidate evaluations, and political behavior.
